title: xyops: A server monitor and a ticketing system rolled into one

sections.title: Transcript
paragraphs: If you've ever had a cron job fail at 3:00 a.m. and had no idea why, you need this. It's a complete replacement for your cron tab, but it's also a server monitor and a ticketing system rolled into one. Here is the magic. It doesn't just run your scripts blindly. It tracks the CPU and RAM of every single job. And if something crashes, it doesn't just send a vague error email. It autocreates a ticket with a full snapshot of exactly what the server was doing at that split
